capture_note: The reference time is the automation run's UTC start time. Exact browser retrieval wall-clock timestamps and HTTP response headers were not retained. Provider timestamps are preserved separately; no missing timestamp is inferred.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The small raw Kraken/OKX last-price gap reflects asynchronous venue snapshots and USD/USDT basis rather than an executable arbitrage.
competing_hypotheses.support: Different instruments and provider timestamps; Kraken timestamp missing and OKX snapshot is stale.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Spot is trading near Kraken's 24-hour open/VWAP while remaining below OKX's 24-hour open.
competing_hypotheses.support: Kraken last is 0.089% above its open and 0.024% above VWAP; OKX last is 0.690% below its open.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Perpetual positioning may have a small negative mark/index basis alongside positive last funding.
competing_hypotheses.support: Binance mark/index basis is approximately -3.99 bps and returned last funding is +0.009747% per 8h.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: The premium-index response is stale; open interest and liquidation tape are unavailable; funding interval freshness is not established.

source_independence: Kraken, OKX and Binance are separate primary venue endpoints. Their instruments, timestamp semantics and data scopes differ; they do not constitute a synchronized multi-venue observation.

model_admission.reason: No provider-synchronized fresh snapshot, Kraken event timestamp, normalized USD/USDT basis, full depth, current open interest, liquidation tape, exchange flows or raw HTTP wire-byte receipts.
